course_position.stage_name: Consolidation, Fluency, Confidence, and Integrated Review

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Repair a social misunderstanding about time, place, or expectation.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Two people discover that a social plan was understood differently.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Noticing a misunderstanding, softening the correction, and agreeing on a shared plan.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik realize that a dinner or meetup has been understood differently and use polite repair language to avoid irritation.

main_focus.name: soft correction with jag trodde, jag uppfattade det som, and det blev nog ett missförstånd
main_focus.description: Use polite phrases to correct an assumption while keeping the interaction cooperative.
model_examples: Jag trodde att vi skulle ses klockan sju.
Det blev nog ett missförstånd om platsen.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use soft correction or misunderstanding phrases naturally 3-5 times.

allowed_supporting_grammar: subordinate clauses with när and om

useful_chunks: Ska vi säga samma tid men en annan plats?
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use social repair chunks naturally with a cooperative tone.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker mentions a plan detail that does not match the other interpretation.
dialogue_shape.middle: They clarify the misunderstanding, soften the correction, and compare two fixes.
dialogue_shape.ending: They settle on one shared plan and reduce any tension.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat soft correction frames without making the situation feel scripted

focus: the plan detail that was misunderstood
the shared plan after the misunderstanding is resolved

sentence_focus: one sentence with Jag trodde att
one sentence with Jag uppfattade det som att
one cooperative sentence proposing a fix
one sentence confirming the corrected social plan
